falsifiable_hypothesis: A third 8xA800 node can accelerate the already-running frozen C65 collection without stopping n1/n2 only if every active launcher obtains the same atomic per-ordinal ownership claim before creating or publishing an output.
parent: The immutable two-node C65 collection rooted at /mnt/h3-wam/eval/c65-c60-deployment-pair-collection-v1.
single_variable: Add node 30137 as an additional executor; jobs, hashes, seeds, execution contract, outcomes, selection and gates remain unchanged.

source_contract_finding.legacy_sequence: complete output -> skip; incomplete existing output -> return failure; absent output -> mkdir -p and run
source_contract_finding.toctou: The absence check and mkdir are separate operations, and mkdir -p does not prove ownership.

rejected_live_options.direct_main_root: A third-node partial directory makes the legacy owner terminate when it reaches that ordinal.
rejected_live_options.third_only_claim_lock: The active n1/n2 launchers never acquire or inspect it.
rejected_live_options.staging_then_publish: Publication between the legacy absence check and mkdir still races; no-replace after legacy mkdir safely declines but yields no acceleration.
rejected_live_options.tail_slice: It relies on a wall-clock lead, but job duration and eight worker cursors have no frozen hard lower bound; it is not a correctness guarantee.

safe_future_contract.claim: All nodes atomically create the same claim/<ordinal> owner record before any output test/create.
safe_future_contract.execution: The owner writes to node/PID-specific staging.
safe_future_contract.publish: Validate result+trajectory first, then atomic renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE) into the canonical output.
safe_future_contract.recovery: Only explicit stale-claim audit may reclaim; completion marker counts canonical published jobs, not attempted jobs.
safe_future_contract.live_migration: Requires coordinated quiescence/restart of both legacy launchers and revised marker accounting, which is outside current authorization.

claim_boundary: This is an outcome-blind concurrency-safety conclusion, not a C65 model/data result.
